responsibility: This file implements the DFA scheduling model for the VR5500 core in the MIPS backend. It describes the integer dispatch pipes, memory unit, MAC, floating-point unit, and branch unit, and it adds important bypass relationships for loads, arithmetic, multiply-add chains, and HI/LO accesses, so GCC can schedule integer and floating-point code according to the VR5500’s execution resources and operand forwarding behavior.
